title: Kiosk Changes and Staff Actions
eyebrow: WisconsinKiosk · redesign row H and C5
lede: Extend, transfer, swap, and change a reservation from the hub, plus staff actions on someone's booking. Every screen calls the kiosk route that already enforces the rule.

sections.heading: Side by side
sections.note: Before = HEAD 3bc36eae build, after = working tree; same created simulator, same fixtures.

pairs.title: C2 · hub buttons
pairs.beforeCap: Extend and Add items both opened the booking sheet; no Transfer; pickups had only Pick up.
pairs.afterCap: Extend opens H1, Transfer opens H2, pickups add Change what's reserved (H5).

sections.heading: New frames (after only)
sections.note: No before exists: the kiosk had none of these screens.

shots.title: H1 · Extend
shots.cap: extend-window fixture: CAM-014 reserved by Maya F. four hours after the due time. Later times are dimmed with 'CAM-014 needed'.

shots.title: H2 · Transfer
shots.cap: Immediate, no accept step (decision 2). The holder is left out of the grid.

shots.title: H4 · Swap a unit
shots.cap: Battery #4 with #12 scanned. Batteries get plain swap only; serialized items also offer 'Something's wrong with it'.

shots.title: H5 · Change a reservation
shots.cap: MIC-09 added and Sony A7S III removed, both staged. Save applies them in order.

shots.title: C5 · Staff on a booking
shots.cap: Fiona (staff) on Dashiell's overdue checkout. No 'Mark returned without scanning': no kiosk route has that permission.

changes.was: A date picker on the booking sheet; the server refused a time that was too late only after Save.
changes.now: The screen reads the extend window first and says how late it can go and why.

changes.was: No transfer on the kiosk hub.
changes.now: Holders hand a checkout (all or some) to anyone on the roster, immediately.

changes.h: Swapping a unit took two steps
changes.was: Remove, then add: two separate saves.
changes.now: One atomic swap; a problem unit goes through the damaged report on the return screen.

changes.h: Reservation edits saved on every tap
changes.was: Each remove saved immediately during pickup.
changes.now: Changes are staged and saved together; any that fail are listed.

verification: xcodebuild WisconsinKiosk on iPad Air 11-inch (M4) iOS 26.5 (created device): BUILD SUCCEEDED
npx vitest run tests/ios-kiosk- : 20 files / 65 tests passed (new tests/ios-kiosk-changes.test.ts checks request bodies and Codable keys against the routes)
notes: Captures prove presentation only; no live-server run of extend, transfer, swap, or reservation save.
The 'Something's wrong' path and the C5 entry from the home booking sheet were not captured (taps don't register in the simulator); C5 is captured through a hub fixture hook.
